# Aprajeeta Singh

> Aprajeeta Singh is the Founder & CEO of Craftcart (handcrafted home, festive and wedding decor and gifting) and its handmade jewellery segment Aprakriti, a content marketer of 9+ years, and a writer and podcaster at "Apravyakti". She writes stories, poetries and blogs in English and Hindi.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aprajeetasingh.com/): overview, latest posts and contact
- [About](https://aprajeetasingh.com/about/): background and key numbers
- [What I do](https://aprajeetasingh.com/work/): Craftcart, Aprakriti, content marketing, writing and the podcast
- [Podcast](https://aprajeetasingh.com/podcast/): the Apravyakti podcast on Spotify
- [Blog](https://aprajeetasingh.com/blog/): stories, life lessons, observations and experiences
- [Contact](https://aprajeetasingh.com/contact/): contact form and social profiles
- [RSS feed](https://aprajeetasingh.com/feed.xml)
